intro.text: An Aimian wanderer who studies the many kinds of spren on Roshar, keeping his notes as markings on his own skin.

items.text: Searching for alespren by getting drunk in Kasitor, Axies was beaten, robbed and left in an alley. He talked a beggar into giving him a blanket, but while watching Cusicesh he lost it to an urchin and was arrested for public indecency.
Rysn found him hanging upside down in the Reshi Isles as punishment for offending the locals' religion; he had gone there hoping to see the spren of a Tai-na.

In Azimir, seven days before the contest of champions, Axies met Baxil at a tea shop and traded him specially prepared red bandages for a gemstone holding an unknown spren. He stayed on in Azimir to hunt a spren drawn by strong emotion in war.

appearance.text: A lanky man with pale, almost blue skin, deep blue eyes and blue fingernails, his body covered in tattoo-like markings ranging from intricate designs to notes on spren.
